title: decree skill --format json
description: What `decree skill --format json` prints on stdout: the skill files it wrote, the ones already identical, and the files it removed from the skill's reference/ folder. Reference: docs/reference/cli.md, Machine-readable output.

written.description: Paths written, relative to the project root (.claude/skills/decree/… or .github/skills/decree/…), in order; text prints these.

unchanged.description: Paths already identical to the installed decree's, so not written, relative to the project root; text prints these followed by `unchanged`.

removed.description: Paths removed from the skill's reference/ folder because decree no longer ships them, relative to the project root; text prints these followed by `removed`.
